tokens.name: surfaces-white
tokens.usage: Page background and the fill of cards, headers and post cards. Figma: Surfaces/White.

tokens.name: surfaces-highlights
tokens.usage: Footer band, Input fields and the ink of the icon set. Figma: Surfaces/Highlights.

tokens.name: surfaces-strokes
tokens.usage: Chip fill; 1px border of Next-Read cards, Input fields, the contact form and the footer top rule. Figma: Surfaces/Strokes.

tokens.name: surfaces-elevation
tokens.usage: 1px chip border and the base hue of the elevation shadow. Figma: Surfaces/Elevation.

tokens.name: surfaces-elevation-20
tokens.usage: Card border and elevation shadow colour (Surfaces/Elevation at 20%). Figma: Surfaces/Elevation-20%.

tokens.name: surfaces-divider
tokens.usage: 1px horizontal rules between posts and sections, and post dates. 9.4:1 on surfaces-white light, 11.9:1 dark. Figma: Surfaces/Divider.

tokens.name: surfaces-divider-20
tokens.usage: Colour of the Highlights effect style (Surfaces/Divider at 20%); that style is no longer used by the Highlight quote. Figma: Surfaces/Divider-20%.

tokens.name: surfaces-captions
tokens.usage: Defined in the file for caption grounds; not used by any component yet. Figma: Surfaces/Captions.

tokens.name: surfaces-dark
tokens.usage: Inverse surface (dark in light theme). Defined in the file, not used by any component yet. Figma: Surfaces/Dark.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, quotes and nav links on surfaces-white, surfaces-highlights and surfaces-strokes (16.6:1 / 15.9:1 / 12:1 light; 16.6 / 13.4 / 9.5 dark). Figma: Text/Primary.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Card descriptions, dates, footer copyright and visited links on surfaces-white and surfaces-highlights (9.4:1 light, 12:1 dark). Figma: Text/Secondary.

tokens.name: text-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on filled buttons (button-dark, button-mid). 12.4:1 on button-dark light, 5.3:1 dark. On button-mid in dark it is 2.6:1 (fails, kept as in the file). Figma: Text/Contrast.

tokens.name: text-highlight
tokens.usage: Accent words inside a headline, e.g. 'without the armor' in the Home h1. 3.1:1 on surfaces-white in light (passes only at 24px+ or bold 19px+). In dark the file maps it to neutral-900, the same colour as the dark page (1:1, invisible); kept as in the file. Figma: Text/Hightlight.

tokens.name: button-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; secondary button border and label (12.9:1 on surfaces-white light, 5.3:1 dark). Figma: Button/Dark.

tokens.name: button-mid
tokens.usage: Hover and focus state of both buttons. As text on surfaces-white: 6.5:1 light, 2.6:1 dark (fails in dark, kept as in the file). Figma: Button/Mid.

tokens.name: button-light
tokens.usage: 2px border of the active Next-Read card. 3.1:1 on surfaces-white light; 1.3:1 dark (fails, kept as in the file). Figma: Button/Light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The mint accent: the icon tile on Cards, nothing else (until Nov 2026 it was also the Highlight bar and quote glyph). Icons in surfaces-highlights on it reach only 1.8:1 in light (fails, kept as in the file). Figma: Accent/Accent.

tokens.name: highlight-rule
tokens.usage: The short 48x2px rule above a Highlight pull quote. Decorative, never text: 3.1:1 on surfaces-white in light, well above 3:1 in dark. Added Nov 2026.

tokens.name: topic-leading-surface
tokens.usage: Leading Teams chip fill (strongest light chip: teal-300 fill). Sub-tags of Leading Teams use the same four tokens. Never a dark fill: dark teal is reserved for the primary button.

tokens.name: topic-leading-stroke
tokens.usage: Leading Teams chip 1px border; on hover the border darkens one step.

tokens.name: topic-leading-text
tokens.usage: Leading Teams chip label; the post count uses it at 75% opacity.

tokens.name: topic-leading-dot
tokens.usage: Leading Teams 8px leading dot.

tokens.name: topic-ai-surface
tokens.usage: AI in Teams chip fill (pale chip: teal-100 fill). Sub-tags of AI in Teams use the same four tokens. Never a dark fill: dark teal is reserved for the primary button.

tokens.name: topic-ai-stroke
tokens.usage: AI in Teams chip 1px border; on hover the border darkens one step.

tokens.name: topic-ai-text
tokens.usage: AI in Teams chip label; the post count uses it at 75% opacity.

tokens.name: topic-ai-dot
tokens.usage: AI in Teams 8px leading dot.

tokens.name: topic-mentoring-surface
tokens.usage: Mentoring chip fill (outline chip: page-colour fill, teal-400 border). Sub-tags of Mentoring use the same four tokens. Never a dark fill: dark teal is reserved for the primary button.

tokens.name: topic-mentoring-stroke
tokens.usage: Mentoring chip 1px border; on hover the border darkens one step.

tokens.name: topic-mentoring-text
tokens.usage: Mentoring chip label; the post count uses it at 75% opacity.

tokens.name: topic-mentoring-dot
tokens.usage: Mentoring 8px leading dot.

tokens.name: topic-personal-surface
tokens.usage: Personal chip fill (neutral chip: the original gray Chip). Sub-tags of Personal use the same four tokens. Never a dark fill: dark teal is reserved for the primary button.

tokens.name: topic-personal-stroke
tokens.usage: Personal chip 1px border; on hover the border darkens one step.

tokens.name: topic-personal-text
tokens.usage: Personal chip label; the post count uses it at 75% opacity.

tokens.name: topic-personal-dot
tokens.usage: Personal 8px leading dot.

tokens.name: teal-900
tokens.usage: Figma Button/Dark: light-theme primary button; topic dot for Leading Teams. Anchor from Figma. Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-800
tokens.usage: Between button-mid and button-dark; available for pressed states. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Figma Button/Mid: hover and focus in both themes; topic dot for AI in Teams. Anchor from Figma. Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: Between brand teal and button-mid; available for states. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-500
tokens.usage: Brand teal (Figma): the script m of the logo, headline accent, dark-theme primary button, topic dot for Mentoring. Anchor from Figma. Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-400
tokens.usage: Leading Teams and Mentoring chip borders. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Leading Teams chip fill; AI in Teams chip border. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-200
tokens.usage: Available for subtle fills and rules. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Lightest teal. AI in Teams chip fill. Interpolated in OKLCH between the Figma anchors (Nov 2026). Primitive: use the semantic tokens in components.

tokens.name: mint-500
tokens.usage: Mint. Feeds accent. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Ink navy: the M of the logo, text in light theme, page in dark theme. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Footer band in dark theme. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text and dividers in light theme; strokes in dark. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Chip border and shadow base. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Strokes in light theme; secondary text in dark. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Footer band and icon ink in light theme; button label in light theme. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Page in light theme; text in dark theme. Primitive from Global Colors: use the semantic tokens above in components.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title on Home and About, inside measure-hero. One per page; its closing words may take text-highlight. Not from Figma (Nov 2026).
styles.sample: I help teams grow by talking things through.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles: 'Stories about leading teams, without the armor', 'About Me'. Fixed 48px line height (Figma H1), so two-line titles sit tight.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles ('Latest stories', 'Highlighted Posts', 'Contact'), Card titles, and post titles when nothing heads them (the Home list in Figma).
styles.sample: Use of AI bots in meetings

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Post titles inside a section headed by an h2, e.g. the stories under 'Latest stories'. Same voice as h2, one step down. Added Nov 2026, not in Figma.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Next-Read card titles. Was h3 until Nov 2026, moved down one level when the serif h3 was added.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Post and About body copy.

styles.name: body-long
styles.usage: Article body for long reads: paragraphs 1.6 line height, space-l between paragraphs, in the measure-reading column.
styles.sample: I'd be lying if I said I had an epiphany.

styles.name: highlights
styles.usage: Small italic quotes. Was the Highlight style until Nov 2026; the Highlight now uses pull-quote. Italic.
styles.sample: The state a team falls into when it simply lacks the tools to face conflict.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: The Highlight pull quote inside an article: one sentence lifted from the body, set large in Medium Italic under a short highlight-rule. Balanced lines (text-wrap: balance). Added Nov 2026.
styles.sample: My arrogance wasn't confidence. It was the only way I knew to avoid asking for help.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and link labels, nav.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, chips, card descriptions, copyright.

styles.name: caption-mono
styles.usage: Eyebrow label above a page title ('Talking Dev'). Space Mono, set in uppercase (text-transform), text-primary.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of display, below 768px when the hero stacks.

styles.name: h1-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of h1 (36px on the same fixed 48px line).

styles.name: h2-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of h2.

styles.name: h3-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of h3.

styles.name: h4-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of h4.

styles.name: body-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of body.

styles.name: body-long-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of body-long. 18px rather than 16 so long reads stay comfortable on a phone.

styles.name: highlights-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of highlights.

styles.name: pull-quote-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of pull-quote, below 600px.

styles.name: button-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of button.

styles.name: caption-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of caption.

styles.name: caption-mono-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile mode of caption-mono. Uppercase.

spacing.note: Desktop values from the Spacing collection. Mobile mode values are the *-mobile tokens (only where they differ).

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps. Same on mobile. Figma: XXS.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Button and link padding, icon-to-label gap; also the card corner radius. Same on mobile. Figma: XS.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap inside post cards and the quote row. Same on mobile. Figma: S.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between Logo and name; between cards in a row. Same on mobile. Figma: M.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Card and header vertical padding; gap between post parts. Mobile: 16px (see space-l-mobile). Figma: L.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Quote padding; gap between About title blocks. Mobile: 24px (see space-xl-mobile). Figma: XL.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; header and footer side padding on desktop. Mobile: 48px (see space-xxl-mobile). Figma: XXL.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Largest section spacing. Mobile: 64px (see space-xxxl-mobile). Figma: XXXL.

tokens.name: space-l-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile mode value of space-l.

tokens.name: space-xl-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile mode value of space-xl.

tokens.name: space-xxl-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile mode value of space-xxl.

tokens.name: space-xxxl-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile mode value of space-xxxl.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners for structure: Next-Read cards, header, footer, the contact form and links.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small interactive pieces: Buttons (primary and secondary), Chips and topic tags, and Input fields. Added Nov 2026 to soften the touch points without losing the editorial tone; not in Figma (the file uses square corners).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the right-hand corners of the Highlight quote (spacing XS bound to corner radius in Figma).

tokens.name: shadow-elevation
tokens.usage: Effect style Elevation: header bar, Cards, and the hover state of Next-Read cards.

tokens.name: shadow-highlights
tokens.usage: Effect style Highlights. Still defined in the file but no longer used: the Highlight quote dropped its glow (Nov 2026).

layout.note: Column widths, page container, gutters and breakpoints. Not from Figma: added for long-form articles and large screens (Nov 2026).

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of any text block (paragraphs, titles, lists, the blog list, About). Text never exceeds 800px at any screen size, for readability (WCAG 1.4.8 recommends lines of about 80 characters or fewer).

tokens.name: measure-reading
tokens.usage: Article body column: about 70 characters per line at body-long. Title, meta and closing align to it.

tokens.name: measure-hero
tokens.usage: Hero text block (eyebrow, display title, lead, actions) on Home and About: 700px of content, with the page gutter as padding outside it, never inside. Narrows only when the hero photo would reach the text.

tokens.name: measure-lead
tokens.usage: The lead paragraph under the hero title, inside measure-hero.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Page container: header, hero, sections and footer content sit in a centred 1440px box. Backgrounds (hero photo, footer band) still run edge to edge. Below 1440 the page is fluid.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Side padding inside the container from 1024px up (same as space-xxl).

tokens.name: gutter-md
tokens.usage: Side padding from 600px to 1023px (tablet).

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Side padding below 600px (phones).

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Below this: phone layout, *-mobile type and spacing, Library in 2 columns.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Below this: the hero stacks (photo above, text below) and the header nav collapses.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: From this up: desktop gutter (96px) and Library in 4 columns; 600–1023 uses 3 columns.
